manifest.name: dsh-cliproxyapi-provider
manifest.description: CLIProxyAPI provider for DeepSeek Harness with local auto-discovery, dynamic model sync, and native model switching.

dshCompat.note: Targets public DSH 0.2.1 configForms and volatile configuration APIs; no Desktop-only APIs.

scripts.build: node scripts/harness-paths.mjs --write && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsdown && node scripts/verify-client-loader.mjs && node scripts/harness-paths.mjs --write-anchor
scripts.prepublishOnly: pnpm run test && pnpm run build

manifest.author: ChadCSong

bundle.text:
# Standard DSH bundle layer. The official base bundle already mounts
# @deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai; this plugin discovers CPA and manages one route
# inside that adapter through the public settings service.
- insert:
    - id: llm-cliproxyapi-auto
      name: dsh-cliproxyapi-provider

readme.text:
[](https://github.com/ChadCSong/dsh-cliproxyapi-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[](LICENSE)

An auto-discovery [CLIProxyAPI](https://github.com/router-for-me/CLIProxyAPI) provider for
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH).

It discovers a local CPA service and synchronizes the live model catalog into DSH's native model picker.

> [简体中文说明](README.zh-CN.md)

Generic OpenAI-compatible routes usually require a manually maintained base URL and model list. This
plugin treats CLIProxyAPI as a first-class, dynamic DSH provider:

- **Zero-address local setup** — probes `127.0.0.1:8317`, `localhost:8317`, and `[::1]:8317`.
- **Live model discovery** — reads `/v1/models?client_version=pi`, with standard `data[].id` fallback.
- **Native model switching** — models appear under `CLIProxyAPI (auto)` in DSH's model picker.
- **Newest versions first** — versions are sorted newest-first inside each model family.
- **Native capability sync** — imports context/output limits, reasoning support, and image input
  when CPA reports them.
- **Automatic refresh** — CPA account or model changes are picked up without reinstalling the plugin.
- **Credential-safe** — the API key is stored through DSH's credential service, not in `settings.yaml`.
- **Standard DSH bundle** — works with DSH Web, headless profiles, and DSH Desktop; it is not a
  Desktop-only extension.

- DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.2` (official Desktop or a matching Web/headless host)
- Node.js `22.19+` or `24+`
- A running CLIProxyAPI instance

Plugin `0.3.0` targets the public DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` contracts. Its conservative
`engines.dsh` range is `>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.2.2-0`; later DSH lines require another compatibility check.
For DSH `0.1.5`, stay on plugin `0.1.9`. This release is not backward-compatible with the old settings API.

Install directly from GitHub into the profile you use:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:ChadCSong/dsh-cliproxyapi-provider
```

For the official Desktop app, use **Plugins → Add plugin** inside the app and enter the GitHub
spec above (or the `.tgz` asset from a GitHub Release). Do not use an unrelated global CLI to manage
the app-owned `desktop` profile. Installing into `web` does not update Desktop.

Restart the host once after installing/updating this plugin. DSH's HMR transaction context must not
be inherited by the background route writer. Subsequent setting edits apply live without a restart.
No manual profile patching is needed;
the standard DSH bundle declaration lives in `package.json` and `cordis.patch.yml`.

```sh
git clone https://github.com/ChadCSong/dsh-cliproxyapi-provider.git
cd dsh-cliproxyapi-provider
pnpm install
pnpm build

Replace `web` with the profile you actually use.

1. Start CLIProxyAPI. Leave the URL empty when it listens on the default port, `8317`.
2. Open **Plugins → dsh-cliproxyapi-provider** in DSH; settings are on the bundle's detail page.
3. If CPA bearer authentication is enabled, enter the API key once.
4. Return to a conversation and select any model under **CLIProxyAPI (auto)** in DSH's native picker.

Useful commands:

```text
/cpa-status
/cpa-refresh
```

`/cpa-status` reports the current endpoint and synchronized model count. `/cpa-refresh` immediately
probes CPA and refreshes the DSH model catalog.

In the CPA plugin details, save the existing URL/key, then use **Refresh models**
under **Optional: image generation**. This reads the full `/v1/models` catalog,
not the Pi/chat-filtered catalog. Select a model from the dropdown (no typed IDs),
select its image protocol, and enable the feature. The default is **off**.

- Common GPT Image / Grok Imagine Image names use OpenAI `/v1/images/generations`;
  Gemini image names use `/v1beta/models/{model}:generateContent`.
- The image dropdown only shows IDs or names containing `image` (case-insensitive),
  without changing the chat model list. Unknown image-named aliases need an explicit
  OpenAI Images or Gemini protocol. Availability depends on the actual CPA response.
- The bundled `/cpa-image` skill and `cpa_generate_image` tool are registered only
  while enabled with a selected model and a resolvable protocol. DSH's normal
  catalogs advertise them to the agent; no global skill files are written.
- Say “generate an illustration of …”, or invoke `/cpa-image`. Each call makes
  **one text-to-image request** using the saved CPA endpoint and credentials.
  Reference-image editing and batch generation are not implemented.
- Images are validated and saved by DSH's durable attachment service. Results
  include a local image link; an image content block is included only when the
  conversation model declares image input. The conversation model is not changed.
- Requests may consume quota. There are **no automatic retries**; after a timeout,
  check upstr

Desktop and Web use DSH's authenticated carrier for catalog reads. Only the
owner may read this endpoint; it accepts no client-supplied URL or secret.

DSH 0.2 uses the bundle's profile entry ID, `llm-cliproxyapi-auto`, as the form namespace.
Prefer the UI; the equivalent profile patch is:

```yaml
- id: llm-cliproxyapi-auto
  config:
    enabled: true
    # Empty means local auto-discovery. Remote CPA is also supported.

Candidates are deduplicated and tried in this order:

1. Explicit `baseURL` setting
2. `CLIPROXYAPI_BASE_URL` from the DSH launch environment
3. Local loopback candidates on port `8317`

A non-loopback service is contacted only when you explicitly configure it.

`apiKeyEnv` is a credential reference, not the secret itself. The settings UI writes the key through
DSH's credential service. The default reference is `CLIPROXYAPI_API_KEY`.
Resolution follows the host's saved-credential/environment policy. Settings fields save atomically;
the credential is saved separately, only after the settings are accepted. A rejected save retains
the remaining drafts. If another editor changed the same settings, discard and re-edit before retrying.

Discovery owns model membership/order and the plugin's endpoint/protocol/credential reference.
Native route options (such as timeouts and compatibility flags) and edited model fields are preserved.
Image-input capability always follows CPA, removing any synthetic flag left by the old vision bridge.
On the first refresh after a restart, existing model fields win conservatively; during the same run,
unchanged generated fields track CPA metadata updates. Explicit model lists cannot coexist with
native `modelOverrides`. No separate vision model or image preprocessing is installed.

Upgrading from an old plugin does not migrate arbitrary legacy `settings.yaml` sections. Verify the
settings in the new detail page. Credentials remain in DSH's store; a visible old model list alone
does not prove the plugin is running—check the component state and `/cpa-status`.

The default, `openai-completions`, uses CPA's `/v1/chat/completions` route. Select
`openai-responses` only when your CPA deployment exposes the target models through the Responses API.

The plugin forwards the input capabilities reported by CPA. Models that declare image input receive images
through DSH's official adapter; text-only models remain text-only. There is no separate vision model, image-to-text
preprocessing, or capability override. DSH applies its native compatibility rules when a session contains images.

The plugin manages one route in DSH's official `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai` adapter through the public
settings contract. It does not patch Harness or reimplement model transport. Streaming, tool calls,
attachments, reasoning, image handling, and errors continue through the official adapter.

The host bundle imports no Electron or `dsh-plugin-desktop` APIs. Its settings card uses public DSH
client services and slots, allowing the same package to run in CLI/Web and Desktop profiles.

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm test
pnpm typecheck
pnpm build

When developing against a local Harness checkout:

```sh
DSH_CHECKOUT=/absolute/path/to/deepseek-harness pnpm test
DSH_CHECKOUT=/absolute/path/to/deepseek-harness pnpm build
```

Alternatively, point `DSH_PACKAGES_ROOT` at a DSH `node_modules` directory. Generated local path files
are ignored by Git and never included in published packages.

Automatic discovery only contacts loopback addresses. The plugin never writes a literal API key to its
settings, model cache, or logs. See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) to report a vulnerability privately.

Issues and pull requests are welcome. For behavior changes, please include or update Vitest coverage and
verify `pnpm test`, `pnpm typecheck`, and `pnpm build` before submitting.

[](LICENSE)

面向 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（DSH）的
[CLIProxyAPI](https://github.com/router-for-me/CLIProxyAPI) 自动发现与模型同步插件。

它能自动发现本地 CPA 服务，并把实时模型目录同步到 DSH 原生模型选择器。

> [English](README.md)

- **本地地址零配置**：依次探测 `127.0.0.1:8317`、`localhost:8317` 和 `[::1]:8317`。
- **动态模型发现**：读取 `/v1/models?client_version=pi`，同时兼容标准 `data[].id` 格式。
- **原生模型切换**：所有模型进入 DSH 的模型选择器，显示在 `CLIProxyAPI (auto)` 分组下。
- **新版本在上**：同一模型家族内按版本倒序排列。
- **同步原生能力**：同步上下文上限、输出上限、reasoning 和图片输入能力。
- **自动刷新**：CPA 增删账号或模型后，无需重装插件。
- **安全保存 Key**：API Key 通过 DSH credential service 保存，不写入 `settings.yaml`。
- **标准 DSH 插件**：同一份包支持 DSH Web、headless profile 和 DSH Desktop，不是 Desktop 私有插件。

- DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.2`（官方桌面版或同版本 Web/headless 主机）
- Node.js `22.19+` 或 `24+`
- 已启动的 CLIProxyAPI 服务

插件 `0.3.0` 以 DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` 的公开接口为基准，保守声明兼容范围
`>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.2.2-0`；后续 DSH 版本线需重新验证。DSH `0.1.5` 用户请保留插件
`0.1.9`，本次新版不再兼容旧设置 API。

安装到你使用的 DSH profile：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:ChadCSong/dsh-cliproxyapi-provider
```

官方桌面版请在 App 内通过 **插件 → 添加插件**，输入上述 GitHub 地址规范或 GitHub Release
的 `.tgz` 安装包地址。不要用不相关的全局 CLI 修改 App 管理的 `desktop` profile。
安装到 `web` 不会同时更新桌面版。

安装或更新本插件后请重启一次 App/主机，让后台同步任务在 DSH 热重载事务之外启动。
之后修改插件设置无需重启，会自动生效。
插件已经通过 `package.json` 和 `cordis.patch.yml` 声明标准
DSH bundle，不需要手动修改 profile。

```sh
git clone https://github.com/ChadCSong/dsh-cliproxyapi-provider.git
cd dsh-cliproxyapi-provider
pnpm install
pnpm build

请把 `web` 换成你实际使用的 profile。

1. 启动 CLIProxyAPI。使用默认 `8317` 端口时，CPA 地址可以留空。
2. 打开 DSH 的 **插件 → dsh-cliproxyapi-provider**，设置就在插件详情页。
3. CPA 开启 bearer 鉴权时，填写一次 API Key。
4. 回到会话，在 DSH 原生模型选择器的 **CLIProxyAPI (auto)** 分组中选择模型。

还可以使用：

```text
/cpa-status
/cpa-refresh
```

`/cpa-status` 查看当前连接地址和已同步模型数量；`/cpa-refresh` 立即重新探测并刷新模型目录。

在插件详情页先保存现有 CPA 地址和 Key，点击「图片生成」区域的「刷新模型列表」。
这里独立读取完整 `/v1/models`，不使用 Pi/聊天过滤目录。生图模型直接从下拉框选择，
不需要输入 ID。选定协议并开启开关即可；默认关闭。

- 常见 GPT Image / Grok Imagine Image 名称使用 `/v1/images/generations`；
  Gemini 生图名称使用 `/v1beta/models/{model}:generateContent`。
- 生图下拉框只显示 ID 或名称包含 `image` 的模型（不区分大小写），不影响聊天模型列表。
  未知生图别名需选择 OpenAI Images 或 Gemini 协议，可用性以 CPA 实际返回为准。
- 开启且选定模型与可识别协议后，注册内置 `/cpa-image` 技能及 `cpa_generate_image`
  工具，由 DSH 正常技能/工具目录告诉模型可用能力，不写入全局技能目录。
- 直接说「帮我生成一张……」或使用 `/cpa-image`。每次调用生成一张图片，复用当前
  CPA 地址和凭据；此版本仅支持文生图，不支持参考图编辑、批量生成。
- DSH 附件服务验证并持久保存图片，结果包含本地图片链接；只有主模型支持读图时才
  同时返回图片内容块，不修改主对话模型或它的原生能力声明。
- 生图可能消耗额度，不自动重试；超时后先确认上游用量。取消本地请求不保证上游退款。
- 关闭开关即移除技能和工具并取消在途请求。只接收内联 PNG/JPEG/WebP，拒绝自动下载
  上游返回的 URL。模型列表接口仅供经过 DSH 认证的所有者读取，不接收客户端地址或 Key。

DSH 0.2 使用 profile 条目 ID `llm-cliproxyapi-auto` 作为配置表单命名空间。
推荐通过界面设置，等效 profile patch 如下：

```yaml
- id: llm-cliproxyapi-auto
  config:
    enabled: true
    # 留空即自动探测，也支持显式填写远程 CPA 地址

插件去重后按以下顺序探测：

1. 设置中明确填写的 `baseURL`
2. DSH 启动环境中的 `CLIPROXYAPI_BASE_URL`
3. 本机 `8317` 端口的 loopback 候选地址

只有你明确配置时，插件才会访问非本机地址。

`apiKeyEnv` 是凭据引用名，不是明文密钥。设置界面通过 DSH credential service 写入 API Key，
默认引用名为 `CLIPROXYAPI_API_KEY`。
读取遵循 DSH 主机的已保存凭据/环境变量策略。普通配置一次性提交成功后，才单独保存 Key；
失败时保留尚未保存的输入。若遇到其他编辑器造成的版本冲突，请放弃草稿后重新编辑。

插件管理模型列表和顺序，以及插件设置中的地址、协议和凭据引用；保留原生界面设置的超时、
协议兼容参数和模型字段修改。图片输入能力始终以 CPA 为准，避免保留旧版读图桥生成的虚假
能力标记。重启后的第一次刷新会保守保留已有模型调参；同一运行期间，
未被用户修改的生成字段继续跟随 CPA 元数据更新。显式模型列表不能与原生 `modelOverrides`
同时使用。不会恢复独立读图模型或图片预处理。

旧插件升级不会自动迁移任意旧 `settings.yaml` 段，请在新详情页核对设置；已有凭据仍由 DSH
保管。能看到旧模型列表不代表插件已运行，应同时确认组件状态及 `/cpa-status`。

默认 `openai-completions`，使用 CPA 的 `/v1/chat/completions`。只有 CPA 部署要求通过 Responses API
调用目标模型时，才需要切换为 `openai-responses`。

插件只同步 CPA 返回的原生输入能力。声明支持图片的模型由 DSH 官方 adapter 直接接收图片，
纯文本模型仍保持纯文本能力。插件不再提供独立读图模型、图片转文字预处理或能力覆盖；会话中
存在图片时，由 DSH 本体执行原生兼容性检查。

插件通过公开的 settings contract 管理 DSH 官方 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai` adapter 中的一条
route；不修改 Harness，也不自行复制模型传输层。因此流式响应、工具调用、附件、reasoning、
图片处理和错误处理仍由官方 adapter 负责。

Host 代码不导入 Electron 或 `dsh-plugin-desktop` API，设置卡片也只使用公开 DSH client service/slot，
所以它可以同时用于 CLI/Web 和 Desktop profile。

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm test
pnpm typecheck
pnpm build

针对本地 Harness 源码开发时：

```sh
DSH_CHECKOUT=/absolute/path/to/deepseek-harness pnpm test
DSH_CHECKOUT=/absolute/path/to/deepseek-harness pnpm build
```

也可以让 `DSH_PACKAGES_ROOT` 指向 DSH 的 `node_modules`。构建生成的本地路径文件已被 Git 忽略，
不会进入发布包。

自动探测只访问 loopback 地址。插件不会把明文 API Key 写入设置、模型缓存或日志。安全问题请参考
[SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) 私下报告。

欢迎提交 Issue 和 Pull Request。修改行为时请补充或更新测试，并确保 `pnpm test`、
`pnpm typecheck` 和 `pnpm build` 通过。
